MOOD V3 · Exercise photo review

Cart and exercise images are static photos only. Exercise-video thumbnails are never used; an exercise without a photo shows the monogram tile. In use = the photo the app shows today. Missing = eligible exercises with no photo (monogram). Removed = old mappings taken out for showing the wrong movement (reference only). Mark each photo in use as Confirmed or Needs change, with an optional note. Marks save automatically in this browser. Click a photo to enlarge.
This browser is blocking local storage, so marks will be lost when the page closes. Use Export JSON before closing.
